title: Force-Modulated Dexterity: Unified Compliance for Contact-Rich Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Teleoperation is widely used to collect high-quality demonstrations for robot learning. Dexterous manipulation, however, requires coordinated control of motion and contact forces. Operators can specify motion, but struggle to reproduce the subtle force adjustments of human manipulation without feeling the robot's contacts. We introduce Force-Modulated Dexterity (FOMO-Dex), a unified compliance formulation for contact-rich manipulation. FOMO-Dex expresses nominal actions in coordinates defined by task geometry and contact structure. It applies force-driven motion corrections along selected directions while leaving the remaining command components unchanged. Across card picking, paper cutting, screwdriving, and nut-and-bolt assembly, FOMO-Dex reduces excessive contact forces compared with stiff control. translated_title: 力调制灵巧性：面向接触丰富操作的统一柔顺控制
translated_abstract: 遥操作被广泛用于为机器人学习收集高质量的示范数据。然而，灵巧操作需要对运动和接触力进行协调控制。操作者可以指定运动，但在无法感知机器人接触的情况下，难以复现人类操作中细微的力调整。我们提出了力调制灵巧性（FOMO-Dex），这是一种面向接触丰富操作的统一柔顺性建模方法。FOMO-Dex 在由任务几何结构和接触结构所定义的坐标系中表达标称动作，并沿选定的方向施加由力驱动的运动修正，同时保持其余指令分量不变。在卡片拾取、剪纸、拧螺丝以及螺母螺栓装配等任务中，与刚性控制相比，FOMO-Dex 减少了过大的接触力。用户研究表明，操作者在短暂练习后，每小时能够收集到更多成功的示范数据。在策略学习方面，模仿……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 FOMO-Dex，一种统一的柔顺性框架，它在任务几何与接触结构定义的坐标系下沿选定方向施加力驱动的运动修正，使遥操作无需触觉反馈也能协调运动与接触力，从而减少过大接触力并提高示范数据收集的成功率。
en_tdlr: FOMO-Dex proposes a unified compliance formulation that applies force-driven motion corrections along selected directions in coordinates defined by task geometry and contact structure, enabling teleoperators to coordinate motion and contact forces without haptic feedback, thereby reducing excessive contact forces and improving demonstration data collection for contact-rich dexterous manipulation.
